provider: BIG Satu Peta Jawa Tengah sublayer 25, with ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS as the national official counterpart
scope: Public provincial land-ownership layer; broader Wonosobo-regency boxes contain records, but no tested Wonosobo-city feature was returned.
schemaAndCrs: EPSG:4326 polygon layer. Public fields are objectid, kecamatan, kelurahan, tipehak, nib, shape; only nib and geometry are safe for a retained parcel sample.
nativeIdentity: nib is the preferred native parcel identity if a feature is independently retrieved; objectid is only a service OID and no synthetic identity was created.

fieldMapping.nib: Native Nomor Identifikasi Bidang; not retrieved for Wonosobo city.
fieldMapping.objectid: Service object identifier, not retained as canonical identity.

requestOutcome: BIG service directory and layer metadata succeeded. Wonosobo-city bounded query and kecamatan='Wonosobo' count query returned zero; wider/regency count queries returned records. BHUMI landing/map succeeded, but the anonymous published-layer JSON response was not usable for parcel features.
retainedProperties: No GeoJSON retained because no Wonosobo-city safe native-ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
unsafeDataPolicy: Owner, titleholder, address, contact, tax/account, legal-description, rights-detail, tipehak, and other source attributes were not retained.
officialCustodyEvidence: BIG Satu Peta and ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS are official national/provincial geospatial sources. A distinct public Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Wonosobo parcel API was not located.
limits: The WUP point was preserved exactly and was not shifted to force a hit.
A zero city query is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Broader layer records do not prove Wonosobo-city coverage.
No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
RuntimeReadiness remains held pending independent serial review.
uncertainty: Independent review must confirm current BIG coverage around the urban area, BHUMI anonymous feature access, native NIB stability, and adapter safety before admission.
